name: t1-pdf-attached
about: 固定合法单页PDF从正式WS submit_turn调用read_file；命中verified-tool须同时观察预期工具结果，再继续模型回合。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/vision
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        vision:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
          multimodal:
            input: [text, image, pdf]
telemetry:
  enabled: false
